question: May the public harmonic-oscillator models adopt Pint as a mandatory runtime dependency behind immutable typed project quantity records, represent Unitless as a first-class unit, and retain the existing version-one numerical JSON through an explicit nondimensional serializer boundary?

options.summary: Adopt Pint behind immutable typed project quantity records.
options.consequence: Add a Python-3.14-compatible Pint runtime dependency, refresh the lockfile, make harmonic-oscillator model values unit-aware, retain Unitless as a real unit, and preserve historical version-one numerical artifact bytes through typed adaptation.

options.summary: Implement project-owned unit arithmetic without a dependency.
options.consequence: Avoid a runtime dependency but assume maintenance and scientific-correctness responsibility for unit parsing, dimensional algebra, conversion, NumPy integration, and compatibility.

recommendation: Option A: use Pint rather than implementing a general unit algebra, isolate it behind immutable typed project records, and distinguish explicit nondimensionalization from intrinsically unitless quantities.
blocked_scope: Before human authorization, dependency declarations, lockfile changes, unit-aware public-contract implementation, and serializer adaptation were blocked. Production electronic-structure execution, external computation, scientific validation, uncertainty quantification, release, publication, commit, push, and migration of unrelated scientific domains remain outside this decision.
safe_scope: Read-only dependency metadata, compatibility, license, current-source, retained-artifact, and public-contract inspection; deterministic design and reporting.
normalized_decision: Option A approved: adopt Pint for the public harmonic-oscillator unit contract behind immutable typed project quantity records, make Unitless a first-class unit, represent nondimensionalization explicitly, and preserve retained version-one numerical artifacts.
authorized_scope: Add Pint as a mandatory Python runtime dependency using a compatible bounded 0.26 release range and refresh python/uv.lock; verify upstream Python 3.14 support and BSD license metadata; implement immutable strictly typed scalar, vector, and matrix quantity records needed by the harmonic-oscillator public models; expose Unitless as a first-class unit; add an explicit harmonic-oscillator nondimensionalization boundary; migrate the three public harmonic-oscillator models, comparator, campaign composition, tests, and documentation; preserve retained version-one result bytes and numerical values through typed serializer adaptation; run applicable software and numerical verification. Do not migrate unrelated domains, execute protected scientific calculations, claim scientific validation or uncertainty quantification, publish, release, commit, or push.
resumption_status: Authorized harmonic-oscillator unit-aware public-contract implementation may proceed; no unrelated successor is activated.
